repo.name: tintin
repo.description: TinTin++, aka tt++, is an extensible console MUD client.

readme.summary: The README is a minimal stub that defers all useful content to external files, providing no actionable information for new users.
readme.top_issue: No installation instructions, quick start, or examples are included — everything is redirected to separate documents not present in the README.

injection_risks.description: The 'e' option executes a command using script_driver() which may lead to code injection if not properly sanitized
The 'r' option reads a file using do_read() which may lead to path traversal or other issues if not properly validated

critical_findings: Potential code injection vulnerability in script_driver()
Lack of input validation for command line arguments
security.summary: TinTin++ has several security concerns, including potential code injection vulnerabilities and lack of input validation, which may expose the application to various attacks.

common_complaints: Build system failures and regressions (configure, missing files)
Character encoding and localization issues (Swedish characters, direction localization)
Display/rendering bugs (bottom bar, color loss with patches)
Missing configuration options for safety/control (preventing implicit server sends)
Feature request backlog (one open since July 2023)
sentiment.summary: Moderately healthy project with good issue closure rate on bugs, but one feature request unresolved since 2023 and minimal maintainer engagement depth suggest waning capacity or interest in feature development.

red_flags: Occasional use of AI hallucination references
Some responses are brief and could be more detailed
communication.summary: The maintainer is generally helpful and patient, with clear explanations, but the technical depth can vary and some responses are somewhat brief.

concerns: No commits in past 6 months despite recent last commit date (2026-01-29)
7 open issues with zero recent closure or addressing
No active contributors in past 6 months
No merged PRs in past 6 months indicating no recent development
Unknown release information makes versioning unclear
positive_signals: Last commit exists (45 days ago), suggesting not completely abandoned
No stale PRs indicates strict maintenance boundaries
maintenance.summary: Package is stale with unresolved open issues and no active maintenance or contributor activity for 6 months.
